newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 11.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from the noon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station on Monday. Reuters has not confirmed these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The opposition Lithuanian Democratic Labour party wants a vote of no-confidence against the healthcare, culture, agriculture and interior ministers.
- The government decided to finance the studies of piano star Gabrielius Alekna in Juilliard music school in New York.
